name: Koganei Takeru
source:
The protagonist of this story. His mother died young and his father works late. He often has dinner at his childhood friend's house.

From the various troubles that occur there, he is filled with the pheromones of his childhood friend's mother, who is more erotic than her.  He gets caught up in various fantasies, and each time he does so, he makes her jealous.

[From [url=http://kikenn.sakura.ne.jp/KuroyokamI/topindexPL0002.htm]official site[/url]]
